### income_ext_post_death_excess_repayment (hub `post_death_deposit_settlement_f9f1795b`, baseline `post_death_repayment_amount_fd83f37c`)
- Rule (from whom recovered; direct settlement recorded together against the deposit, unrepaid part stays owed for offset; recorded once per deposit; joint-tier overpayment = part not entitled): hub paragraphs + table + "What the records show". Equivalent.
- Tool contract `settle_post_death_deposit_f655a739` (user-owned): hub matches the docstring. Equivalent.
- Baseline.rule: computation doc (deposit = most recently issued installment; whole deposit excess; overpayment = whole excess; no offset; repay whole). Equivalent.
- Factors:
  - `repayment_excess_of_deposit`: joint, survivor continuing, after first death -> deposit less entitlement; period-certain, due on or before end -> none; otherwise -> baseline whole. Carried with boundary cases (death date itself not "after").
  - `repayment_survivor_entitlement`: joint & deposit > survivor installment now -> survivor % of deposit, cent; joint & not more -> whole deposit; otherwise -> baseline nothing. Carried.
  - `repayment_share_of_excess`: this calendar year + federal withheld + no bank return -> 1 − withheld/deposit; bank return -> 1 − returned/deposit; otherwise 1; overpayment = excess × share, cent. Carried; "bank return" = recovery recorded as returned by the bank and linked to the deposit (compute `recovery_method='bank_reclamation'`).
  - `repayment_part_left_to_offset`: held for latest held date after first death -> 25 % of (survivor % of held, cent), cent, capped; nothing held & next installment within 10 days -> 25 % of survivor installment, capped; otherwise none. Carried with figure 10 and 25 %.
- Prerequisite: none declared. Consistent.
- Overwrite (4 clauses): `income_evt_overpayment_recovery` clause 1, 2, 3 retired in `overpayment_recovery_rules_7699a4e8` items 1–3; `income_death_of_annuitant` "every installment paid … after the date of death … is an overpayment" retired in `death_of_annuitant_provisions_b018843c` §5. Correct. The eligibility `one_overpayment_per_installment` has the identical sentence as retired clause 1; the KB marks it retired with that clause ("The same sentence served as the condition … that condition is no longer in force either") and carries the replacement "recorded once against that deposit". Entailed by the overwrite; not KB legislation.

- Rule (one-step settlement after confirmed death: living payee's share released by the contract's payment method, rest forfeited, no interest, never an overpayment): hub opening + table. Equivalent.

- **Prerequisite 1** (problem `income_ext_post_death_excess_repayment`, form state): "The survivor share of a held installment is fixed only after every installment deposited at the joint amount after the first death carries a repayment entry for its excess." — verbatim in the blocked hub ("Standing conditions"), same-form restatement in the bulleted "Restated in the same terms … the survivor share of a held installment is not yet fixed". In no other document. - **Prerequisite 2** (problem `income_ext_returned_installment_reissue`, form state): "A held installment that fell due after the first death is not released until every installment held for a payment date on or before that death stands released." — verbatim in the blocked hub, same-form restatement in the bullets. PASS.
- Baseline.rule: computation doc (latest held date; whole released; joint installment = most recently issued; tax-free capped at purchase amount — factor default; federal at contract election; no state; nothing applied; amount sent "less … any amount applied" — source wording). Equivalent.
- Factors:
  - `survivor_release_share`: joint & survivor continuing & after first death -> survivor % of joint installment, cent, never more than held; life only / cash refund after death -> nothing; otherwise -> baseline whole. Carried.
  - `survivor_release_joint_installment`: increase on an anniversary after the held date (and on or before today) -> amount held; increase after death and on or before held date while held at the last annuitant installment -> held × (1+cola), cent; otherwise -> baseline most recently issued. Carried.
  - `survivor_release_investment`: tiers 1–2 in `survivor_release_investment_60bbc174`; tier 3 = baseline cap. Carried.
  - `survivor_release_withholding_rate`: own election / non-owner survivor 10 % / otherwise -> baseline. Carried.
  - `survivor_release_overpayment_offset`: outstanding & payments continuing -> 25 % of released share, cent, capped at outstanding; outstanding & none continuing -> whole share capped; otherwise none; outstanding = overpayments recorded less recoveries recorded. Carried.
  - `survivor_release_state_tax`: carried.

## bijection_verdict
**PASS.** All atoms of `income_ext_returned_installment_reissue`, `income_ext_post_death_excess_repayment` and `income_ext_survivor_held_release` (rules, every tier of their 14 factor ladders, baselines, both prerequisites, tool contracts, retired surfaces and the base clauses on the path) correspond at the level of entailment. First revision.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
- PS4: the reissue policy withholds federal tax at the contract's (owner's) election even when the reissue goes to a non-owner survivor, whereas the arrears and release policies give a non-owner payee a 10 % default; the KB renders each faithfully.
- PS5: `repayment_part_left_to_offset` compute takes tier 2 whenever tier 1 fails (it does not test "nothing is held"), so a contract holding only an installment due on or before the first death would follow tier 2 in compute but neither tier in the source sentence and the KB. Not reached in task 1 (latest hold 2026-09-01 is after the death).
